parsed_artifact.contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5 so n=6 lies outside published CKgP range; residual tetragonal/Hurwitz geometry is required) and with the packet’s C66-TATE-SUPPORT bottleneck. Independent primary checks. (1) Riemann–Hurwitz for a smooth degree-4 cover C→P^1 of genus 6: 2g−2=4(−2)+R gives R=18 simple branch points, so the balanced tetragonal Hurwitz stack admits a finite (branched) morphism to an open of M_{0,18}, matching the finding’s geometric setup. (2) Genus-0 moduli are mixed/pure Tate in the expected sense: Keel proves the rational Chow and cohomology rings of Mbar_{0,n} are tautological for all n; open configuration spaces of points on P^1 likewise carry mixed-Tate cohomology. (3) For a finite morphism f:H→U⊂M_{0,18}, projection formula / Leray give H^*(H;Q)≅H^*(U;Rf_*Q). When f is finite étale (or on the étale locus), Rf_*Q is a local system of rank deg(f); Hurwitz braid monodromy on branch-point configuration spaces is in general nonabelian, so this local system need not be a sum of constant Tate twists. Constant-coefficient mixed-Tate cohomology of U therefore does not imply mixed-Tate cohomology of H or of a projective-bundle open over H. (4) Rational averaging / transfer: for a Galois cover with group G one has H^*(U;Q)≅H^*(H;Q)^G, so Tate-ness of the cover implies Tate-ness of G-invariants on the base; the converse fails, and averaging cannot manufacture Tate structure on nontrivial isotypics from Tate structure on the base alone. (5) SRC-0004 (Canning–Larson, arXiv:2208.02357v2) records the dual Chow permanence: CKgP descends along proper surjective DM morphisms (Lemma 3.10) but is not asserted to ascend along finite covers—consistent with the same one-way transfer principle. Mild scope note only: the obstruction is to the bare implication “finite over open of M_{0,18} ⇒ mixed-Tate Hurwitz/projective-bundle open”; it does not assert that the Hurwitz stack is non-Tate, only that this route does not prove it is Tate. Distinct from packet FND-0053 (S_6-covers of relative configuration/linear systems: different cover and monodromy source), FND-0054 (declaring the Hurwitz space rational/Tate upgrades a prediction to a theorem without proof: different logical shape), and FND-0002/FND-0009 (CKgP non-ascent along finite étale ordering covers: Chow permanence, different setting). Do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent primary-source verification of Riemann–Hurwitz branch count, genus-0 Tate input, finite-pushforward/local-system bookkeeping, and one-way rational averaging.
